interface_authority: Trader produces execution-intent and mutation-request interfaces; Position Registry owns position-state acceptance interface
mutation_authority: Trader requests position mutation; Position Registry accepts, rejects, records, corrects, and reconciles canonical position mutation
reconciliation_authority: Position Registry reconciles canonical position state while consuming Trader execution context

interface_authority: Broker is authoritative producer of fill, acknowledgement, correction, and broker-reconciliation evidence consumed by Position Registry
reconciliation_authority: Position Registry reconciles canonical position implications

evidence_authority: Authorization identity, validity, revocation, and consumption references must be preserved with position mutation evidence
interface_authority: Authorizations interface authority bounded by governing doctrine
mutation_authority: Position Registry never mutates authorization state or identity
reconciliation_authority: Authorization reconciliation remains with Authorizations; Position Registry records dependency status

evidence_authority: Risk approval, restriction, revocation, and escalation references must be preserved with position mutation evidence
interface_authority: Risk interface authority bounded by governing doctrine
mutation_authority: Position Registry never mutates risk state or risk decision identity
reconciliation_authority: Risk reconciliation remains with Risk; Position Registry records dependency status and fails closed on unresolved material risk conflict
